exposure: infants born to women who gained more than the recommended weight during pregnancy
infants born to women who gained less than the recommended weight during pregnancy
gestational diabetes mellitus not requiring insulin
cohort: 634 full-term infants born to mothers with diabetes
finding: In women with diabetes, higher gestational weight gain can lead to Caesarean section delivery, infant macrosomia and other neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was predicted by gestational diabetes requiring insulin.
